input.oracle: INPUT ONLY ordered {index,accepted,error}; complete for timing; recorded prefix permitted only for capture. Error No error iff accepted. Rejection prefix ends at first failure; accepted prefix must be full.
input.oracleReason: Nonempty string for pre-script rejection; otherwise null.
input.expectedError: First script error or OK for script rows; null for pre-script rejection.
input.oracleProvenance: Nonempty externally bound provenance label; oracle_scope owns operational semantics.
input.sourceIdentity: Four nonempty strings or null; externally pinned registration provenance; no transaction payload serialization.

output.preScript: accepted and first_script_error null; both vectors []; input_attempts_per_iteration 0; untimed_control_passes 0; cached_verify_nanoseconds null; timing_performed false. Timing emits each requested evaluation with unchanged setup/policy receipt, no script calls.

output.counts: known_prefix_inputs=len input oracle; observed_tail_inputs=inputs-known_prefix_inputs for admitted, else0. Timing requires full oracle so tails0. untimed_control_passes2 only admitted. input_attempt_count_kind=source-derived-all-input-loop-not-instrumented.

output.clocks: cached_verify_nanoseconds excludes decode/cache/context/precompute/admission/control/output. cache_total includes nested coins_context and precompute_checker; do not sum. policy_preflight_nanoseconds is exclusive CheckRegularTransaction plus context-preservation/policy intervals, excludes cache; annual null.
